# CEO Business Balance

> Financial clarity and independence for service-based solopreneurs. In my world, being a CEO means being a Calm, Empowered Owner — of your business, your numbers, and your decisions.

Founded by Stacy Luft, MBA. 30+ years in financial operations and cash flow management. Former bookkeeping instructor at Hofstra University.

## Who We Serve

Service-based solopreneurs who want financial clarity without becoming accountants: coaches, consultants, wellness practitioners, therapists, attorneys, writers, and creatives. Especially those who have been avoiding their finances and feel embarrassed or overwhelmed by their numbers.

## Signature Framework

The Sovereign Three™ is a three-step financial clarity framework for service-based solopreneurs.

- Know Your Numbers: Building calm, consistent visibility into your business finances — without shame or overwhelm
- Claim Your Rhythm: Creating financial systems and schedules that work with your natural energy, not against it
- Hold Your Shape: Setting aligned pricing and boundaries that protect your time, income, and peace

Full framework: https://ceobusinessbalance.com/the-sovereign-three/

## Services

- Calm Books Circle: Done-for-you monthly bookkeeping for solopreneurs, including plain-language financial summaries and community access ($225/month) — https://ceobusinessbalance.com/calm-books/
- Momentum Mentorship: Financial mentorship and strategic guidance for solopreneurs ready to make confident money decisions — https://ceobusinessbalance.com/momentum/
- Journey Pathway: Free community membership with access to financial education, workshops, and monthly Progress Circles — https://ceobusinessbalance.com/journey/
